map.每 2 位数字交叉编码为 5 条 + 5 空: Every 2 digits are interleaved into 5 bars + 5 spaces
map.校验位：GTIN-14 mod 10（从右往左 3、1 交替加权）: Check digit: GTIN-14 modulo 10 (weights 3 and 1 alternating from right to left)
map.ITF（Interleaved 2 of 5）是纯数字、高密度条码：把数字两两配: ITF (Interleaved 2 of 5) is a purely numeric, high-density barcode: digits are paired up, the first deciding the positions of 5 bars (wide or narrow) and the second those of 5 spaces, interleaved within the same span — so it is far shorter than Code 39 at the same length. Of each character's 5 elements, 2 are wide (the wide-to-narrow ratio is usually 2:1 or 3:1). ITF can only represent an even number of digits and is commonly used for ITF-14 on the outer cartons of corrugated boxes (carrying a GTIN-14). Because it has no self-checking and is prone to short reads, a black bearer bar is usually added to prevent misreads during angled scans.
map.外箱物流标识：ITF-14 印在瓦楞纸箱外表面，承载 GTIN-14，是配送中心: Outer carton logistics labels: ITF-14 is printed on the outside of corrugated cartons and carries the GTIN-14. It is the primary barcode scanned at distribution centres and warehouses on receipt, usually together with top and bottom bearer bars.
map.包装层级换算：GTIN-14 的第一位是包装指示符（0 表示未知或单品，1–8: Packaging level mapping: the first digit of a GTIN-14 is the packaging indicator (0 means unknown or a single unit, 1–8 denote different packaging levels). It distinguishes "a case of 12 bottles" from "a single bottle" when computing the check digit.

map.为什么 ITF 必须是偶数位数字？: Why must ITF use an even number of digits?
map.ITF 把数字两两配对，第一位决定条、第二位决定空，交织在同一段宽度内。位数为奇: ITF pairs digits up: the first decides the bars and the second the spaces, interleaved within the same span. With an odd digit count the last digit has no partner, so a leading 0 must be added to make the count even — which is also why ITF-14 is fixed at 14 digits.
map.护边框（Bearer Bar）有什么用？: What is the bearer bar for?
map.ITF 是连续型条码、缺乏自校验，手持扫描器斜着划过时容易只扫到一部分条空而误读: ITF is a continuous barcode without self-checking, so a handheld scanner passing at an angle can pick up only part of the bars and spaces and misread it (a short read). Adding a solid black border around the barcode forces the scan line to cross it completely, significantly reducing misreads — the recommended practice for ITF-14.
